title: Adopt, Adapt, or Create Pathway Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Use a three-fact rule of thumb to choose adopt, adapt, create, or keep searching for four teacher cases, then explore which facts change the answer.

learningObjectives: The learner will use a three-fact decision rule (fit to the course, whether revision is permitted, and time available) to choose adopt, adapt, create, or keep searching for four teacher cases, with at least 3 of 4 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The terms OER adoption, OER adaptation, OER creation, and revise permission

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Does the resource fit the course outcomes?
commonMisconceptions: Creating a resource is always the best choice because you control everything
Any free resource may be adapted
A partial fit can always be fixed
assessmentOpportunities: Fit is Full, revision is not permitted, time is Little. Which pathway?
Fit is None, revision is permitted, time is Little. Which pathway?
Which one fact changes the answer only when fit is None?
Why is "create" not always the best choice?

controls.name: Four pathway buttons
controls.description: choose Adopt, Adapt, Create, or Keep searching for the case.

controls.name: Explore the rule
controls.description: on the results screen, opens three drop-down lists (fit, revision permitted, time available) that show the pathway, the rule number, and which facts matter.
